methods.label: Find the least number of full recipes
methods.explanation:
The students need a total of
\[
108\cdot2=216\text{ cookies}.
\]
Because only full recipes are allowed, compare nearby whole numbers of recipes. Fourteen recipes make \(14\cdot15=210\) cookies, which is too few. Fifteen recipes make \(15\cdot15=225\) cookies, which is enough. Thus \(15\) is the least number of full recipes needed.

Each recipe uses \(2\) eggs, so these recipes require \(15\cdot2=30\) eggs. A half-dozen contains \(6\) eggs, and
\[
30\div6=5.
\]
Walter should buy \(5\) half-dozens, choice \(\text{C}\).
methods.levelReason: The method explains rounding up through adjacent whole-number multiples, without formal floor or ceiling notation.
